name: arith_orderOf_two_zmod_three_pow
informal: 2 is a primitive root modulo every power of 3: its order mod 3^(n+1) is 2·3^n = φ(3^(n+1)) — the order divides φ; Uses Mathlib2.nt2_lte_three_two_pow_three_pow_add_one at the key step: 2^(3^n) ≡ -1 ≠ 1 rules out divisors of 3^n, and the exact valuation v_3(2^(3^(n-1)) + 1) = n (with 3 ∤ 2^(3^(n-1)) - 1) rules out 2·3^(n-1).
